Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= "2025-10-21T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2025-11-28T00:00:00.000Z" | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS status_code_200_counter = COUNT(*) WHERE response == "200", status_code_5xx_counter = COUNT(*) WHERE response >= "500" AND response < "600", avg_bytes = AVG(bytes) BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
